title: Data Store Write
text: Write data to data store, 2 inputs, no direct feedthrough, {Sample time} sets Sample time; {Data store name} sets the name of data store to which block, {Data store memory block} sets the data Store Memory block name Read-only: block, {Corresponding Data Store Read blocks} sets the list of corresponding Data Store Read blocks Read-only: block, {Elements in the array (Signals in the bus)} sets the elements in associated data, {Specify element(s) to assign} sets the mATLAB expression defining the elements to assign, {Assigned element(s)} sets the list of selected, {Enable indexing}, {Number of dimensions}, {Index mode}, {Index Option} sets the index method for subelements and {Index} sets the indices or starting index of subelements. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Values to write to data store scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.name: IdxN
ports.summary: N th index signal scalar | vector

params.name: Data store name
params.values: Name of data store to which block writes A (default) | name of data store

params.name: Data store memory block
params.values: Data Store Memory block name Read-only: block path

params.name: Corresponding Data Store Read blocks
params.values: List of corresponding Data Store Read blocks Read-only: block path

params.name: Elements in the array (Signals in the bus)
params.values: Elements in associated data store string | character vector

params.name: Specify element(s) to assign
params.values: MATLAB expression defining the elements to assign string | character vector

params.name: Assigned element(s)
params.values: List of selected elements string | character vector

params.name: Enable indexing
params.values: Enable indexing to specify subelements of data store element to write off (default) | on

params.name: Number of dimensions
params.values: Number of dimensions of data store element 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Index Option
params.values: Index method for subelements Index vector (dialog) (default) | Select all | Index vector (port) | Starting index (dialog) | Starting index (port)

params.name: Index
params.values: Indices or starting index of subelements 1 (default) | integer | vector of integers
